# Arecleoch Wind Farm and extension

Arecleoch Wind Farm and extension is a wind, solar and storage project tracked on slava.it.com. The archive holds 2 community posts from 2 groups, latest 2026-10-02. 6 register records are listed (3 REPD, 3 NESO TEC). Their statuses differ, so no single status is given. Top recurring themes: Onshore Wind (1).

## Register facts

| Item | Value | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| Register records | 6 listed (3 REPD, 3 NESO TEC). Statuses: Scoping (2), Under Construction (2), Operational (1), Built (1) | register |

## Register records

Each row is one register record with its own identifier; records are not combined. Relationships are stated only where a register links the records, and are otherwise labelled as unlinked or unverified. REPD dates are the record's update date and the date of the status event where one is recorded. The NESO files give no status date; the date shown is the MW effective-from date.

| Register | Identifier | Name as recorded | Status | Capacity | Date | Relationship |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| REPD | 3258 | Arecleoch Windfarm | Operational | 120 MW | record updated 2011-10-25; status event 2011-06-14 | Original wind farm; the name is spelled 'Arecleoch Windfarm'; no identifier is shared with the REPD NESO rows. |
| NESO TEC | PRO-000012-1 | Arecleoch | Built | connected 114 MW; cumulative 114 MW | no effective date in the file | Stage 1 of NESO project PRO-000012; relation to REPD 3258 is unverified (same site name, no shared identifier). |
| NESO TEC | PRO-000012-2 | Arecleoch | Scoping | connected 0 MW; cumulative 330 MW | MW effective from 2032-06-15 | Stage 2 of NESO project PRO-000012. |
| REPD | 6798 | Arecleoch Wind Farm (extension) | Under Construction | 72.8 MW | record updated 2025-07-25; status event 2025-06-01 | Extension: the REPD name is 'Arecleoch Wind Farm (extension)'. |
| REPD | 7882 | Arecleoch Wind Farm (extension) | Under Construction | 20 MW | record updated 2025-07-25; status event 2025-06-01 | Extension battery storage; REPD links it to 6798 (storage co-location). |
| NESO TEC | PRO-001111 | Arecleoch Extension Windfarm | Scoping | connected 0 MW; cumulative 72.8 MW | MW effective from 2026-08-31 | 'Arecleoch Extension Windfarm'; same capacity (72.8 MW) as REPD 6798 but no shared identifier, so the relation is unverified. |
